---
title: "Finite-population correction"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(chromVAR)
  library(SingleCellExperiment)
  library(betterChromVAR)
  library(Matrix)
  library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
  library(BiocParallel)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
})
register(MulticoreParam(10, progress=TRUE))
```

```{r}
f <- "GSE168851_scATAC_K562_TimeCourse_Peak_Matrix_SE.rds"
if(!file.exists(f)){
  options(timeout=10000)
  download.file("https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE168nnn/GSE168851/suppl/GSE168851%5FscATAC%5FK562%5FTimeCourse%5FPeak%5FMatrix%5FSE%2Erds%2Egz",
                paste0(f,".gz"))
  R.utils::gunzip(paste0(f,".gz"))
}
```

Subset to 2k cells:

```{r}
sce <- readRDS("GSE168851_scATAC_K562_TimeCourse_Peak_Matrix_SE.rds")
sce <- addGCBias(sce, BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
sce <- sce[,which(sce$sgAssignFinal=="UNK")]
set.seed(123)
sce <- sce[,sample.int(ncol(sce), 2000)]
w <- which(rowSums(assay(sce))>0)
sce <- sce[w,]
assayNames(sce) <- "counts"
```

Motif matches:

```{r}
if(file.exists("motif_ix.SE.rds")){
  motif_ix <- readRDS("motif_ix.SE.rds")
}else{
  library(motifmatchr)
  library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
  source("/common/scripts/getNonRedundantMotifs.R")
  motifs <- getNonRedundantMotifs("PWMatrix")
  motif_ix <- matchMotifs(motifs, sce, genome=BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
  saveRDS(motif_ix, "motif_ix.SE.rds")
}

row.names(sce) <- as.character(granges(sce))
row.names(motif_ix) <- gsub(":+","",as.character(granges(motif_ix)),fixed=TRUE)
moi <- assay(motif_ix)[row.names(sce),]
```

Select motifs spanning the whole range of proportions

```{r}
p <- colSums(moi)/nrow(moi)
o <- seq_len(ncol(moi))[order(p)]
sel <- unique(c(tail(o, 60), o[round(seq(1, length(o)-60, length.out=60))]))
moi <- moi[,sel]
```

Split in halves

```{r}
sp <- betterChromVAR:::.thinCounts(assay(sce), 0.5, pairs=TRUE)
se2 <- SummarizedExperiment(list(counts=cbind(sp$A, sp$B)), rowData=rowData(sce))
colnames(se2) <- paste0("c", seq_len(2*ncol(sce)))
```

run methods

```{r}
z <- list()
z$chromVAR <- computeDeviations(se2, moi,
  background_peaks=getBackgroundPeaks(se2, niterations=100))
z[["betterChromVAR(fpc=F)"]] <- betterChromVAR(se2, moi, fpc=FALSE, minCount=NULL, tol=NULL)
z[["betterChromVAR(fpc=T)"]] <- betterChromVAR(se2, moi, fpc=TRUE, minCount=NULL, tol=NULL)
```

compute calibration

```{r}
n <- ncol(sce)
res <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(z, \(dev){
  z <- assay(dev, "z")
  data.frame( motif=row.names(z),
              sp.diff=rowMeans((z[,1:n]-z[,n+1:n])^2, na.rm=TRUE)/2,
              rowSDs=rowSds(z))
}), .id="method")
res$method <- factor(res$method, unique(res$method))
res$p <- (colSums(moi)/nrow(moi))[res$motif]
```


```{r}
p1 <- ggplot(res, aes(p, rowSDs, color=method)) + 
  geom_point() + geom_smooth(method=MASS::rlm, se=FALSE) + theme_bw() +
  labs(x="Proportion of the peaks matching the motif",
       y="Standard deviation of the z-scores")
p2 <- ggplot(res, aes(p, sp.diff, color=method)) + 
  geom_point() + geom_smooth(method=MASS::rlm, se=FALSE) + theme_bw() +
  labs(x="Proportion of the peaks matching the motif",
       y="Split-half calibration")
pdf("SDcalibration.pdf", width=10, height=5)
p1 + p2 + plot_layout(guide="collect") & 
  theme(legend.position="bottom")
dev.off()
```
